picks.editorial_note: A White House-backed consortium uniting 15 universities across 10 states to share leadership-class AI computing infrastructure signals a major federal push to decentralize supercomputing access for AI research in the Southeast.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, built with UIUC and opened to researchers nationwide, meaningfully expands shared compute capacity for AI research beyond a single institution.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2M, five-year Army Research Office award to a UCF-led team to advance AI-enhanced optical sensing and imaging represents a substantial federal defense research investment with real downstream applications.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: The AURORA robot-controlled, AI-enhanced cloud lab at Arkansas, part of a $20M NSF-led effort, could substantially accelerate the discovery of quantum materials by automating experimentation at scale.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: ASU's AIR Platform, backed by an Intel donation, democratizes access to AI supercomputing for all students and researchers, a notable model for broadening AI research participation.
picks.title: ASU provides access to AI-supercomputing for all

picks.editorial_note: Rico Sennrich's ACL Test of Time Award recognizes subword tokenization (BPE), a foundational technique underpinning nearly every modern large language model — a rare case of a decade-old university innovation now central to the entire field.
picks.title: A Smart Computer

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech researchers developing probes to detect internal warning signs of unsafe LLM behavior address a pressing AI safety concern directly motivated by a real 2026 incident.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $5M, three-year commitment to Georgia Tech to broaden researcher access to AI tools for scientific discovery marks a significant industry-academia funding partnership.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives $5 Million From Google.org to Expand Access to AI for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: The UK AI minister's announcement of new government measures to guard against AI risks, delivered at Imperial College London, reflects growing policy urgency around AI safety regulation.
picks.title: AI minister announces measures to protect against AI risks in speech at Imperial

picks.editorial_note: Three Carnegie Mellon faculty joining the $16M Schmidt Sciences AI2050 Early Career Fellows cohort highlights significant philanthropic investment in the next generation of AI researchers.
picks.title: Three SCS Faculty Members Named 2026 AI2050 Early Career Fellows
